knownGapsByPage: Retain imported environment editor, query/mutation receivers and migration/onboarding implementations as required delegated families.

modeDecision.reason: Personalization positively contains Codex host memory and instructions alongside account controls. Authentication labels, page names and native capability presence do not prove branch-level product-mode ownership; all new goals remain unknown.

dependencyBoundary.keepFirstParty: Page routing, permission and identity guards, draft/control state, request adapters, orchestration, layout/assignment glue and provider lifetimes.
dependencyBoundary.externalize: React/compiler runtime, UI/query/schema and utility implementations use existing package inventories. Native Micro/Chronicle and private services require independently qualified dependencies/adapters; imported first-party delegates are not mislabeled as third-party.
dependencyBoundary.versionAuthority: Existing dependency-import/embedded inventories; no versions inferred from aliases.
